Enhance Camera and Frustum Classes with Visualization Features

- Added visualization logic to the Camera class, including methods for creating actors, updating appearance, and selection states.
- Expanded the Frustum class to manage visual properties, including selection and highlight states, and added methods for creating and updating actors.
- Implemented texture handling for frustum image planes and improved appearance updates based on selection.
- Refactored ray visualization in MVATViewer to support multiple rays with distinct colors, enhancing the display of ray origins and terminal points.
- Cleaned up unused constants and improved widget management in the QtCameraGrid class.
- Removed legacy code related to persistent ray visualization and optimized actor management for better performance.

Refactor Camera and Frustum classes for improved geometry handling and visualization

- Removed unused visualization methods from Camera class, simplifying its interface.
- Updated Frustum class to focus solely on geometry representation, delegating visualization to MVATWindow.
- Enhanced texture creation for frustum image planes, ensuring robust handling of QImage conversion.
- Introduced caching mechanisms in Frustum for geometry to optimize performance.
- Refactored MVATViewer to implement a data-oriented approach for ray visualization, utilizing persistent meshes.
- Added methods for managing maximum ray capacity and updating ray visualizations in-place, improving rendering efficiency.
- Cleaned up legacy code related to ray visualization, streamlining the overall architecture.

- Updated `ConfidenceWindow` to display additional morphology metrics including orientation, compactness, elongation, rectangularity, and eccentricity.
- Modified `MainWindow` to integrate the new spatial metrics export functionality into the UI.
- Ensured compatibility with existing annotation types and metrics, providing a comprehensive export feature for spatial analysis.
